title: redact keeps a URL password or a Bearer credential that is $ and word characters, taking it for a $NAME placeholder
goal: redact replaces a URL user:password@ password and an Authorization credential that is $ followed by word characters (a real password such as $Tr0ub4dor), or a gate records the operator's choice between that and keeping $NAME environment references; SP-yyjwfjtc review gap 2: _credential accepts \$\w+ as a placeholder by fullmatch.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;v="$Fake"+"Pass12345x";o=R.redact("https://user:"+v+"@db.example.com");print(o);sys.exit(1 if v in o else 0)
